[ASSISTANT_SAID] Artificial intelligence and machine learning enable online retailers to personalize offerings and provide relevant product recommendations.

[ASSISTANT_SAID] AI and machine learning are likely to have the biggest impact on the eCommerce industry, enhancing personalized shopping experiences and customer loyalty.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] AI-powered chatbots and virtual assistants can improve customer service and streamline operations.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] AI and machine learning can aid in fraud detection and prevention, making online transactions more secure.

[ASSISTANT_SAID] Smaller retailers can leverage affordable technologies to improve customer experiences and compete with larger companies.

[ASSISTANT_SAID] Emerging trends include hyper-personalization, social commerce, voice commerce, and green/sustainable eCommerce.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Hyper-personalization involves creating individualized experiences based on customer data.
